newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN OTC SHARES DRAGGED BY REFINERY CLOSURES.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN OTC SHARES DRAGGED BY REFINERY CLOSURES.

text.p: Refineries destined for closure under the government's reform programme sank on Romania's Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market on Friday.
Trading in other shares was subdued with prices closing mixed.
Players rushed to sell their positions in the three refineries slated for closure in plans announced on Thursday by Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea at the urging of international lenders.
"Almost anyone who had bought shares in Petrotel, Vega and Darmanesti refineries threw them on the market and tried to sell," one trader said. There was thin volumes as few buyers were in evidence.
Petrotel plunged 8,400 lei to close at 5,100, Vega fell 9,000 lei to 5,000 and Darmanesti shed 8,100 lei to close at 5,900.
Two independent indices computed by brokerage houses, based on average prices and market capitalisation, edged down from the previous session. A third was slightly higher.
The VAB-RA all-share index edged down by 0.5 percent to 6,574.5 points. The BIG-OTC gained 0.58 to 4,657.63 points and the CAS-RQ went down 1.11 percent to 1,007 points.
Gainers outnumbered losers by 155 to 135. Prices for 282 stocks stayed unchanged.
Investors' interest was focused on Friday on other oil refineries and on cement makers.
Petrobrazi refinery closed flat at 45,000 lei, even though some deals were concluded at 46,000 at midsession. Petromidia, another refinery in demand, ended 500 lei firmer at 40,500.
Traders said an announcement that negotiations would start next week for the sell-off of 51 percent of Petromidia had no effect on trading as it became public after the closing.

Romania's main privatisation agency, the State Ownership Fund (FPS), said it would start negotiations next Tuesday with Daewoo of South Korea and subsequently with Glencore of Switzerland and Petromidia USA Ltd.
Cement maker Romcim closed 3,000 lei down from the previuos session at 120,000, but operators said some deals were clinched at 125,000.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD and CAS-RQ on CRAS02 and CRAS03. ($=7,447 lei)
